meta_description: A summarized list of necessary and specific agendas for the non-binary community, from ABRANB consultations and debates.

topics.title: Access to civil registration
items: Name rectification and sex mention as “non-binary” or another self-determined option other than male/female on the birth certificate and all other personal documents, in a streamlined way, without requiring reports, payment, or court proceedings;
Updating all digital systems and institutional forms to add this new option;
Speeding up pending court cases for document rectification of non-binary people.
